## UpdateGate.acquire() method

Acquire the gate for `key`<!-- -->, returning a release function.

**Signature:**


## Remarks

Resolves immediately (with a no-op release) when gating is disabled or `key` is `undefined`<!-- -->. Otherwise parks FIFO until the key has a free slot.
